Offline Kitchen Survivability

01. Fail-Closed Database & Multi-Tenant Isolation

In mission-critical healthcare operations, silent data loss during network interruptions is unacceptable. Shoreline Care OS employs an explicit fail-closed architecture:

  • Elimination of Split-Brain Fallback: When configured with PostgreSQL in production, Shoreline never silently falls back to a temporary local SQLite store on connection failure. Requests halt cleanly with transactional rollbacks, preserving database integrity.
  • Tenant Facility Scoping: Every database table containing clinical or operational data includes a mandatory facility_id foreign key indexed and verified by middleware on every query.
  • Private HTTP Cache Invalidation: Intermediate proxies are prohibited from caching Protected Health Information. All clinical endpoints emit Cache-Control: private, no-cache, must-revalidate tagged with the tenant facility ID.

02. Cryptographic Standards & Key Derivation

Shoreline applies modern cryptographic primitives at every layer of the technology stack:

Argon2id Authentication

Passwords are hashed using memory-hard Argon2id (m=65536, t=3, p=4) with per-user cryptographic salts. Resistant against GPU-accelerated dictionary and rainbow table attacks.

AES-256-GCM Encryption

All persistent database volumes, automated snapshot backups, and stored EDI credentials are encrypted at-rest using AES-256 in Galois/Counter Mode.

Network transmissions enforce TLS 1.3 exclusively, protected by automated HSTS headers (HTTP Strict Transport Security with 1-year max-age and preload directives), Content Security Policy (CSP), and Helmet HTTP protection.

03. Immutable Audit Logging & Chain of Custody

In adherence to CMS-2567 dietary regulations and HIPAA audit rules, Shoreline maintains an append-only audit ledger (audit_log table):

  • Non-Repudiation: Every resident diet order modification, IDDSI texture downgrade, NPO order, and Registered Dietitian EHR triage resolution records the verified actor user ID, previous value, proposed value, and timestamp.
  • Database Immutability Triggers: PostgreSQL triggers prevent UPDATE or DELETE operations against historical audit log rows.
  • HACCP Corrective Action Enforcement: When food or refrigerator temperatures fall outside safe thresholds (<140°F hot hold, >41°F cold hold, <165°F cook temp), the entry cannot be closed without documented corrective actions.

04. Hardware & Kitchen Tablet Ergonomics

Kitchen kiosks operate under demanding physical conditions:

  • Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Direct Connection: Food probe temperatures are collected directly via standard Web Bluetooth LE drivers, bypassing untrusted cloud intermediaries.
  • Offline Mutation Sync Queue: In the event of Wi-Fi interruptions in basement kitchens or walk-in coolers, meal dispatches and HACCP logs are buffered in IndexedDB and re-synchronized upon reconnection.
  • Touch Safety Targets: Mobile and kiosk buttons strictly adhere to ≥ 44px touch targets with high-contrast color indicators to prevent mis-taps during active service lines.

05. Cloud Service Level Agreement (SLA)

Shoreline guarantees 99.9% monthly availability for our managed SaaS multi-tenant API. Availability is defined as successful responses (HTTP < 500) to client requests originating from verified facility networks.
